idea-plugin.name: Warden & Colonial Navy
idea-plugin.description:
Four dark naval themes inspired by the two navies of the game Foxhole. Each faction gets a surface ship and a submarine.

  • Warden Navy Blacksteele: gunmetal hull, wooden deck and banner blue.
  • Warden Navy Nakki: deep water, sonar green and periscope glass.
  • Colonial Navy Conqueror: khaki steel, Colonial green and ochre.
  • Colonial Navy Trident: deep green water, sonar mint and pale deck paint.

Each theme comes with its own editor colour scheme and with:

  • a sea chart background with a sonar display that shows the theme's vessel,
  • 45 nautical icons, with sea mines for breakpoints and crates for folders,
  • a progress bar on which the vessel makes its way along the water,
  • short effects: air bubbles when typing pauses, a torpedo on Delete Line and a sonar ping when a build or run finishes,
  • notifications styled as radio telegram slips and a depth gauge in the status bar.

The progress bar and every effect can be switched off under Settings | Appearance & Behavior | Warden & Colonial Navy. Effects are off in Power Save Mode.

An unofficial fan project. Not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Siege Camp. All artwork is original.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
2.0.0: adds the Colonial Navy themes Conqueror and Trident and redraws all four vessels. The plugin has a new name and id; uninstall Warden Navy 1.0.0 before installing this version.
